keyFindings.description: The sessionInfo comment says a session that re-registered through another listener is reached at its recorded host, else at MachineID. Since 24cd57ef it leaves out the stayed-local clause: a recorded host equal to the owner's machine id goes through the owner's bridge. This is wording only, and it is on the Fast-follow line with stating the address rule once, on hostFor.

Security[untrusted-input], hardening: hostFor dials entry.Host and does not check ValidHost again. While both builds run, a listener built before this PR can store a host such as 'a/b' or 'user@x' without a check. It reaches nothing a valid host could not already reach. Recorded under Not proven / risk.
